title: Great Salt Lake Safari - Discover Antelope Island
blurb:
This is more than a sightseeing drive. Your guides are a Utah locals and former African safari guides who bring a naturalist’s approach to exploring Antelope Island, connecting the wildlife, landscape, ecology, and history into a deeper understanding of the place.

With a maximum of six guests, the experience stays small, relaxed, and personal. We can spend more time watching wildlife, asking questions, photographing a scene, or exploring an interesting stop instead of following the pace of a large bus tour.

Want more flexibility or exclusivity? Our Private Antelope Island State Park Tour is designed for guests who want their group only and greater freedom to shape the pace around photography, birding, family needs, or a special occasion.

Prefer the island at its most atmospheric? Our Great Salt Lake Sunset Safari Tour combines wildlife exploration with evening light, golden-hour photography, and sunset over the Great Salt Lake or visit safariutah.com
